name: MDMEOET
summary: MDMEOET, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-methoxyethylamphetamine or as N-methoxyethyl-MDA, is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and MDxx families. It is the N-methoxyethyl derivative of MDA.

fact.en: It is MDA with a methoxyethyl group on its nitrogen, one of a long run of N-substituted MDA relatives that Alexander Shulgin described in PiHKAL to see how the nitrogen group shapes their effects.
fact.zh: 它就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接甲氧乙基，屬於亞歷山大．舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一長串 N-取代 MDA 親戚之一，用來觀察氮上的基團如何影響作用。
fact.zhHans: 它就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接甲氧乙基，属于亚历山大．舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一长串 N-取代 MDA 亲戚之一，用来观察氮上的基团如何影响作用。
